entity: Duffy for Wisconsin, Sean Duffy's old House campaign committee
what_we_add: $0 raised from donors; the two check dates (2025-10-27, 2026-07-15); the $1M check is the biggest from any dormant campaign committee in 2025-26 (next: $215K)
why: WPR (2026-08-07) states $1.5M from Duffy's old account to Northwoods Future PAC, which spent $2M+ for Alfonso; Badger Project (2026-03-24) and CBS (2026-07-06) had the first $1M, both before the 2026-07-15 check, so no conflict. Wigderson copies the Bulwark (half of the PAC's $3.125M) and Crooks and Liars copies Badger, each counted once.
